title: Inverse image of etale sheaves of sets, abelian groups and rings
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $U_{\Et}$, $V_{\Et}$ the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $b:V_{\Et}\to U_{\Et}$, $W\mapsto U\times_VW$, the base-change functor. For a sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $U_{\Et}$ put $(u_*\mathcal F)(W)=\mathcal F(U\times_VW)$, and for a sheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $V_{\Et}$ let $u^{-1}\mathcal G$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf $U'\mapsto\varinjlim\mathcal G(W)$, the colimit over the pairs $(W/V,\ U'\to U\times_VW$ over $U)$. Then: (1) $u^{-1}$ is a functor from sheaves of sets on $V_{\Et}$ to sheaves of sets on $U_{\Et}$, left adjoint to $u_*$, and it commutes with finite limits; in particular $u^{-1}(*)=*$ for the final (singleton) sheaf and $u^{-1}(\mathcal G_1\times\mathcal G_2)=u^{-1}\mathcal G_1\times u^{-1}\mathcal G_2$ via the projections. (2) If $\mathcal G$ is a sheaf of abelian groups (resp. of commutative rings) on $V_{\Et}$, then $u^{-1}\mathcal G$ with the images under $u^{-1}$ of the structure maps ($+$, $0$, $-$; resp. also $\cdot$ and $1$), via (1), is a sheaf of abelian groups (resp. commutative rings) on $U_{\Et}$; this gives functors $u^{-1}$ on sheaves of abelian groups and of commutative rings, compatible with the forgetful functors to sheaves of sets, left adjoint to $u_*$ on sheaves of abelian groups (resp. rings), whose adjunction bijections and units $\mathcal G\to u_*u^{-1}\mathcal G$ are those of (1) on underlying sheaves of sets. (3) On abelian sheaves the functor of (2) is canonically isomorphic, compatibly with the adjunctions, to the inverse image $u^{-1}:\Ab(V_{\Et})\to\Ab(U_{\Et})$ of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], which is left adjoint to the direct image $u_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]; in particular the underlying sheaf of sets of the abelian inverse image $u^{-1}\mathcal G$ is the set-theoretic inverse image of the underlying sheaf of sets of $\mathcal G$, and the unit $\eta_u$ of the abelian adjunction is, on underlying sheaves of sets, the unit of (1).

source.place: Proposition 00X6 (proposition-get-morphism: u_s exact for a continuous functor commuting with the final object and fibre products, applied to b, which does by the etale-site base change), Definition 00X1 (definition-morphism-sites: f^{-1}=u_s left adjoint to f_*=u^s) and Proposition 00YV (proposition-functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi: the adjoint pair (f^{-1}, f_*) on sheaves of abelian groups and rings, compatible with underlying sheaves of sets); for (3), uniqueness of left adjoints

proof.text: Base change preserves finite limits and is representably flat. Its opposite left Kan extension is left exact by CategoryTheory.preservesFiniteLimits_op_lan_of_flat (imported from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Functor.Flat), applied to Type (u+1). Supply AB5OfSize.{u,u+1} by AB5OfSize_of_univLE from the Mathlib AB5 instance for types. Compose the finite-limit preserving inclusion, this Kan extension, and the set sheafification. This proves PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.etaleSetPullback f). The large-category version avoids the small-category restriction of the originally recorded Mathlib lemma. Continuity of base change supplies the sheaf adjunction used below.
Apply the independent abelian and ring lift lemmas with this finite-limit proof, obtaining ea and its hom-set/operation equations, and Lr, ar, er with their ring hom-set/operation equations.

Choose da and dr to be Iso.refl. Forgetting commutes definitionally with precomposition, so both right-image comparisons are the identity on sections. Their hom-set compatibility statements simplify to the two equations supplied by the lift lemmas.

For each lift, evaluate its hom-set equation at the identity morphism of the inverse image. Adjunction.homEquiv_id identifies the left side with the forgotten algebraic unit. The private proved lemma unit_of_homEquiv rewrites the right side as the set unit followed by R.map of the inverse comparison; compose with R.map of the forward comparison and cancel the inverse. This proves both unit equations. Assemble the witnesses and all eight clauses.

proof_origin.place: N1 specialization of Proposition 00X6 (finite limits), Proposition 00YV (independent coefficient lifts), and elementary deduction of unit compatibility from adjunction hom-set compatibility

split_report.summary: Split by one level along Stacks sites.tex. Step 1: base change b is continuous (new node lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous, Stacks 00WV/00WW with Topologies 0217) and commutes with finite limits (existing Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits), so u_* preserves sheaves of sets. Step 2: u^{-1} = (b_p)^# is left adjoint to u_* (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-sets-left-exact, the set-valued twin of lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-left-exact, plus def-weil-pbc-sheafification; Stacks 00VE, 00WX). Step 3: finite limits (Stacks 00X6 via 00X3/00X5) with the existing lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-finite-limits-objectwise and the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-sets-exact. Step 4: algebraic structures (Stacks 00YV) via two new unsplit nodes: lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-algebraic-structures-objects (sheaves of Ab/rings = group/ring objects of sheaves of sets) and lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-lifts-group-ring-objects (an adjunction with product-preserving left adjoint lifts to group and ring objects; the group part is Mathlib's Adjunction.mapCommGrp, rings are absent); the lift of u_* is identified with the sectionwise direct image. Step 5: clause (3) by uniqueness of left adjoints (Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation). Statement unchanged. Lean: the slopmaster2 upperStar (Defs.lean:227) is for Grothendieck abelian coefficients only; nothing for sets or rings.
